document_role: Structural preparation only, not an actual input manifest or authorization

reference.path: absolute canonical file under owned artifact root

manifest.matrix_report: reference to root-reviewed complete original N3 matrix report
manifest.matrix_report_input: reference exactly bound in that report
manifest.cells: exactly30 unique accepted representatives, any order; each entry below

cell.attempt_id: exact accepted representative ID from matrix
cell.stage_events: one of present {status:present,reference:ref} or absent {status:not_recorded,path:canonical expected path}

later_root_authorization.freeze: reference to separately reviewed freeze-v2.json; old v1 authorization does not authorize this version
later_root_authorization.manifest: reference to later exact input manifest
later_root_authorization.reviewed_metadata_sources: object with exact report and plan relative paths and reviewed SHA values

completed_audit_snapshot.audit: original accepted complete audit reference from matrix
completed_audit_snapshot.auditor_sha256: frozen N3 source inventory scripts/audit_decision_evidence.py SHA

checkpoint_admission: dependencies-v2.json pins exact base-null, exact two named revisions and exact public release path/SHA/metadata; authority base_plan/plan_revisions must match, and first3 accepted representative IDs must match release. No recursive evidence payload read.
